title: Canonical torsion linking pairings and explicit TMF state spaces of closed 3-manifolds
summary: We study the TMF-valued $(3+1)$-dimensional TQFT of Gukov--Krushkal--Meier--Pei and give an explicit description of the TMF-module state space assigned to a closed $3$-manifold. Our starting point is the torsion linking pairing on $H_1$, viewed as a discriminant form. We construct a canonical, computable package of invariants for torsion linking pairings (uniformly for odd and $2$-primary parts), and from it a canonical tokenization together with an explicit symmetric integral matrix representative realizing the same stable class.
